data.gender_notes: Nabeeha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'n-b-h' meaning 'to be good, to be kind, to be gracious'. In Islamic tradition, Nabeeha is a name for a girl who embodies these qualities. The name Nabeeha carries the meaning “Gracious, Pleasing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nabeeha usually hope their child will grow to embody gracious, pleasing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name inspired by the Prophet Muhammad's companions (Sahabah), who were known for their graciousness and kindness to others.
data.etymology: Nabeeha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gracious, Pleasing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nabeeha total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
